entries.proposition: Design: retrospective observational single-centre study of consecutive children given plasma exchange for neuroimmunological disorders, September 2020 to December 2025.
entries.snippet: This retrospective observational study was conducted in the PICU of Sancaktepe

experimental_context.system: 22 children (median age 104 months) who received therapeutic plasma exchange in one tertiary paediatric intensive care unit in Istanbul between 2020 and 2025 for neuroimmunological disorders (6 Guillain-Barre, 6 autoimmune encephalitis, 4 infection-triggered encephalopathy, 3 MOGAD, 2 ADEM, 1 MERS)
experimental_context.comparator: none (descriptive, no control group; all patients also received methylprednisolone and/or IVIG, some rituximab)
experimental_context.endpoint: discharge Pediatric Cerebral Performance Category (unfavourable = 3 or more, or death), mortality, ventilation, MRI evolution
